Just a suggestion for these steps:

Since this test repeats the same keyword with different xpath/header pairs, we can move those pairs into a global list variable. That keeps the test shorter and makes future updates easier.

For example:

#new tab links collection with format: xpath|header name
@{new_tab_links}    //a[@href='#/operations/firmware']|Firmware
...                 //a[@href="#/settings/network"]|Network
...                 //a[@href='#/resource-management/power']|Power
...                 //a[@href="#/logs/event-logs"]|Event logs
...                 //a[@href="#/hardware-status/inventory"]|Inventory and LEDs
...                 //a[@href='#/logs/dumps']|Dumps

Then the test case can be written as:

Verify Overview Opens Link In New Tab
    [Documentation]  Verify if hyperlinks open in a new tab.
    [Tags]  Verify_Overview_Opens_Link_In_New_Tab

    FOR  ${link}  IN  @{new_tab_links}
        ${xpath_new_tab}=  Fetch From Left  ${link}  |
        ${header}=  Fetch From Right  ${link}  |
        Open Link In New Tab  ${xpath_new_tab}  ${header}
    END
